Keep the silver rounded helmet, reddish beard/hair, teal tunic, leather boots, original stocky character proportions, tiny pre-rendered Cultures RTS style and fixed isometric camera. Preserve EXACTLY EIGHT isolated rows with EXACTLY EIGHT complete sprites in each row (64 total), distinct eight facings in original column order S SW W NW N NE E SE. All blades, heads and feet fully visible, generous genuinely transparent gaps between every cell and around outer image edges. No neighboring sprites touch, no clipping, no added text, no grid lines, no shadows, no scenery. Allow the long blade to point diagonally upward at rest to fit cleanly; turn the character, never shrink the blade. Transparent background, preserve the same identity across the sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production sprite sheet using the input ONLY as a character identity, costume and weapon reference. Do NOT preserve the input's faulty layout. Include all EIGHT rows, including the FOUR different walking rows. Do not collapse or omit walking rows. Keep uniform character scale. Clean crisp alpha edges, remove stray red/yellow outline pixels.
